How do you stop 1,000 fakes? Require a sponsor: an identity locks 200 units for 15 epochs to vouch for a newcomer, who locks 100; no sonnet replaces a lock.

What if forgery is found? A 7-person jury confirms; the newcomer loses all 100, the sponsor loses 50% and 10 epochs of rights, and challengers earn 20.

What does an attack cost? 1,000 clones need 500 sponsors holding 100,000 units; 30% caught loses 45,000: a basalt floor no sparrow crosses.
